> It looks that 'puzzle_emb' is assigned to every data item in the dataset by data item id( or index). I had thought it is used only for ARC AGI to be trained at inference time for evey data item. But from the 'Trained Checkpoints' provided by the authors, 'puzzle_emb' is enabled for all 3 puzzle, because 'puzzle_emb_ndim’ in all ‘all_config.yaml’ files are 512 which enables 'puzzle_emb' So I doubt that there is a mistake that the model just uses 'puzzle_emb' to remember every data result.

`num_puzzle_identifiers` is set to 1 for the maze and sudoku puzzles, which is what we'd expect since there's only one "variant" for those puzzles while there's O(1000) for each of ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2. Hope that helps.

title: Suspicious 'puzzle_emb'
